Collections.Name: The Boiling Point Saga
Collections.Description: Stopped the Thermocline cult from cracking the harbour's geothermal vents.

Notes.Description: A materials scientist who survived a reactor flash and now runs hot all the time. Works nights at the university, patrols the docks after.

Stats.Roleplaying: Has to know how things work, and takes them apart to find out.
Stats.Minor twist: You get lost in the details while the clock runs.
Stats.Major twist: Your experiment goes wrong in public.
Stats.Green ability: Overcome a scientific problem using Max; use Min to Boost an ally.

Stats.Roleplaying: Protects the harbour district before anything else.
Stats.Minor twist: A bystander needs saving right now.
Stats.Major twist: Something you care about in the district is destroyed.
Stats.Green ability: Overcome to get civilians out of a zone using Max.
